cells.quote: Regarding lymph node yield, no change points were present for ‘younger’ or ‘older’ surgeons (Fig. 2e). However, the number of lymph nodes removed and examined was higher for ‘younger surgeons’ (median 11 [IQR 5–20]) compared with ‘older surgeons’ (median 5 [IQR 3–9]) [p < 0.001].
cells.note: The surgeons had no prior primary-surgeon experience of esophagectomies before study inclusion; the significant result concerns median lymph node yield, not a change point in the proficiency curve.
